page_title: ClearDisk -- Free macOS Developer Cache Cleaner

summary.name: ClearDisk
summary.one_liner: ClearDisk is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that finds and cleans developer caches such as Xcode DerivedData, node_modules, Docker and package-manager caches.
use_cases: Reclaim disk space taken by Xcode build data
Clean node_modules and Yarn caches across projects
Remove Docker, pip, Cargo or Gradle caches
Find which developer caches use the most space before deleting
Install a privacy-focused disk cleaner via Homebrew
summary.what_it_does: ClearDisk scans the Mac for developer cache types, including Xcode DerivedData, node_modules, CocoaPods, SPM, Homebrew, Docker, pip, Cargo, Go Modules, Gradle, Maven, Flutter/Pub, Xcode Archives, iOS Simulators and Yarn Cache. It shows how much space each cache type uses and offers a project-level view grouping caches by development project. Users can preview sizes and select individual caches or clean everything at once. It runs from the menu bar and states that it makes no network requests, collects no data and has no telemetry.
notable: Menu bar app with no dock icon, about 590 KB in size
Zero network access, analytics or telemetry; runs locally
MIT licensed with full source on GitHub
Covers 15+ developer cache types, compared against CleanMyMac, DaisyDisk and DevCleaner
caveats: Requires macOS; no other platforms are named on the page
Page claims of 50-500 GB of reclaimable space are marketing figures, not verified
